title: event.<deviceRef>.<eventName>
description:
Something happened that has no persistent value — a button was pressed, motion was detected, an alarm self-tested.

Unlike state, events must not be coalesced: two button presses are two facts, and dropping one loses information that cannot be recovered by reading the device.

data.title: Event-specific detail
data.description: Free-form. A multi-press carries its count, a motion event may carry a zone.

feature.description: Which feature emitted it. Present when a device has several features that can emit the same event name.
